name: delta-every-table-oracle-canonicalises-properties
body: The every-table oracle canonicalises the rel properties column (decode then re-encode) because the splice's batched code-rel MERGE leaves the empty column where a full load writes {}, and both decode to the empty map per layers::properties_from_json; every other column of every row is compared raw. Upgrade by setting r.properties to the empty map in apply's step-6 rel re-merge and dropping the normalisation if raw-column identity is required.
